symbols.name: axis count
symbols.meaning: The number of axes on which the layer acts, one axis per chunk; it counts the selected bits.
symbols.quote: Let $D$ be the number of axes on which the layer acts.

symbols.name: chunk width
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in each chunk, where a chunk is a run of consecutive address bits.
symbols.quote: Let $K$ be the number of bits in each chunk.

symbols.name: selected offset
symbols.meaning: The position of the selected bit within each chunk, counted from the least significant end.
symbols.quote: Let $\rho$ be the offset of the selected bit within each chunk, counted from the least significant end, with $0 \le \rho < K$.

symbols.name: first value
symbols.meaning: The first of the two values of a pair, the first input of the two-point map.
symbols.quote: Let $\mu$ and $\nu$ be the two values of a pair.

symbols.name: second value
symbols.meaning: The second of the two values of a pair, the second input of the two-point map.
symbols.quote: Let $\mu$ and $\nu$ be the two values of a pair.

symbols.name: two-point map
symbols.meaning: The map sending a pair of values to their half-sum and half-difference.

symbols.name: identity matrix
symbols.meaning: The $2\times 2$ identity matrix, with ones on the diagonal and zeros elsewhere.

relations.quote: First, the layer expresses its phase frames through the [complex phase network](complex-phase-network.md), as products of two-point kernels $C$ on the selected bits.
The layer rests on [Gaussian dyadics](gaussian-dyadics.md) for this reason.
The layer moves its address chunks by [address-field interchange](address-interchange.md).
The layer applies the length-two case of the [discrete Fourier transform](discrete-fourier-transform.md), $H_0$, to each of the $D$ selected bits independently.
This is the [tensor product](tensor-product.md) of $H_0$ over those bits.

A simultaneous butterfly layer applies the two-point map of a [butterfly](butterfly.md) to several selected address bits at once, and computes the result exactly in a single pass over the stored records.
The layer acts on these $D$ [transform axes](transform-axis.md), one per chunk, where a chunk is a run of consecutive address bits.
Third, the procedure evaluates the whole layer exactly and ends with one final [truncation](truncation.md) of its values.

relations.quote: Second, the layer splits bits into smaller groups by [binary changes of basis](binary-change-of-basis.md).
